security_audit.summary: All 39 static findings are false positives caused by Markdown fences, inline code, relative documentation links, or GitHub metadata. Semantic review found risks from invented personalization details and potentially unsolicited multi-channel follow-ups. No prompt injection or executable command behavior was found.

remediation.issue: Worked examples introduce recipient-specific facts that were not supplied in the example inputs.
remediation.suggestion: Replace unsourced details with placeholders or add them to the input, and require verification before using personalization claims.

remediation.issue: Connectors can send repeated messages and switch channels after no response.
remediation.suggestion: Require approval before sending, enforce opt-outs and rate limits, record consent, and stop immediately after a refusal.

semantic_findings.title: Unverified Personalization in Worked Examples
semantic_findings.description: Worked examples introduce an exact post, shopping behavior, and past brand partners that the example input did not provide. Reusing this pattern could produce deceptive outreach.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Direct comparison shows that the outputs add recipient-specific claims absent from their inputs, despite the separate rule against fabricated content references.

semantic_findings.title: Unsolicited Multi-Channel Follow-Up Automation
semantic_findings.description: The skill can schedule repeated messages and switch channels after no response. Without approval, consent, and rate controls, this could facilitate spam or unwanted contact.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instructions explicitly identify a sending connector and direct a multi-touch cadence that changes channels after no reply.

content.value_statement: Cold outreach often lacks personalization, follow-up structure, and clear negotiation options. This skill creates targeted messages, contact cadences, negotiation scripts, and pipeline trackers.
actual_capabilities: Collects campaign, audience, budget, deliverable, and timeline details before drafting outreach.
Creates primary messages plus short direct-message and formal email versions.
Builds a four-touch follow-up cadence with timing, value additions, and an archive point.
Produces negotiation options for budget gaps, scope changes, value exchanges, and future commitments.
Tracks contacts, stages, next actions, conversion rates, objections, and confirmed terms.
Adapts pitch mechanics for creators, journalists, analysts, launch partners, and advocates.
limitations: Requires accurate target, campaign, budget, and contact details from the user or connected tools.
Does not verify profiles, audience data, past partnerships, testimonials, or contact permissions.
Does not finalize contracts, define embargo terms, or create press releases.
Sending messages and updating external systems require user-approved tools and review.

use_cases.title: Launch a creator campaign
use_cases.description: Draft personalized creator pitches, plan follow-ups, and track responses for a product launch.

use_cases.title: Execute a media pitch
use_cases.description: Turn an approved story angle and media list into concise outreach for journalists or analysts.

use_cases.title: Negotiate partner terms
use_cases.description: Prepare options when a partner request exceeds the available budget or campaign scope.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a first message
prompt_templates.prompt: Write a personalized outreach message for [creator] on [platform]. Use [campaign], [offer], [deliverables], and [timeline]. Mark any missing facts as placeholders.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: one creator and one campaign.

prompt_templates.title: Build a follow-up sequence
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a four-touch follow-up sequence for [target] after no reply. Add new value at each step and archive the contact after Day 21.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: structured follow-up for an unanswered pitch.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a negotiation
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare negotiation scripts for a creator asking [amount] when our budget is [amount]. Offer scope changes, value exchanges, and a respectful decline option.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: resolve a budget and scope gap.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a full outreach pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan outreach for [target list] using the supplied campaign data and contact history. Produce personalized variants, a cadence, negotiation paths, and pipeline priorities.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: coordinate outreach across several targets and stages.

output_examples.input: Draft an Instagram message for Maya, who reviewed refillable packaging, offering 500 dollars for one video.
output_examples.output: Maya, your refillable packaging review made the tradeoffs clear. We are launching a refillable cleanser and offer 500 dollars for one video. Open to details?

output_examples.input: Prepare options for a creator asking 2,000 dollars when the campaign budget is 1,200 dollars.
output: Offer 1,200 dollars for one video with no stories.
Add product and affiliate commission without increasing the cash budget.
Decline respectfully if reduced scope does not meet the creator requirements.

output_examples.input: Summarize a pipeline with eight contacted creators, three replies, one negotiation, and one confirmation.
output_examples.output: Pipeline: eight contacted, three replied, one negotiating, and one confirmed. Response rate is 37.5 percent. Prioritize the active negotiation and schedule approved follow-ups.

best_practices: Provide verified content references, rates, testimonials, contact paths, and campaign claims.
Review every message for consent, accuracy, tone, and channel rules before sending.
Stop follow-ups after a decline or the defined archive point.
anti_patterns: Do not invent recipient details, campaign results, testimonials, or prior relationships.
Do not automate bulk sending without approval, consent controls, and rate limits.
Do not repeat identical messages or contact people daily.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the target, platform, campaign, offer, deliverables, budget, timeline, and verified personalization details.

faq.question: Can this skill send messages?
faq.answer: It can prepare messages and schedules. Sending requires an available connector and user authorization.

faq.question: Does it verify creator information?
faq.answer: No. Verify profiles, audience data, content references, contact paths, and testimonials before use.

faq.question: Can it create a final contract?
faq.answer: No. It prepares negotiation options and confirmed terms for handoff to a contract workflow.

faq.question: Can it support media outreach?
faq.answer: Yes. Supply an approved media list, story angle, claims, and embargo terms from the relevant media workflow.

faq.question: How many follow-ups does it recommend?
faq.answer: It recommends up to three follow-ups over 14 days, then archives the contact on Day 21.
